999008199.text: ふう……全部倒せたわね
やれやれ。これで胞子はなくなりそうかい？

localizations.en: Finally. Should be the end of those spores, yeah?

999008199.text: 胞子濃度、低下中。状況は解決した模様

localizations.en: Spore concentration declining. Situation appears resolved.

999008199.text: よかった……みんな、助かる……かな

localizations.en: That's a relief... Everyone's going to be okay... right?

999008199.text:
安心してる場合？　レスナたちはともかく、ずっと
胞子にさらされ続けた島の人たちが危ないんじゃない？

localizations.en: A little early to relax, don't you think? Resna and the others aside, the people on this island have been breathing spores this whole time. They might be in bad shape.

999008199.text: ！！　町に急ぎましょう！
うぅ……
はぁ、はぁ……

……酷い有様ね。
みんな、胞子のせいで……

localizations.en: ...This is awful. Every last one of them, because of those spores...

999008199.text:
か……身体からキノコが生えてる人が……！　
これ、どうしたら……

localizations.en: S-some of them have mushrooms growing out of their bodies...! What do we do...?

999008199.text:
まったく……言わんこっちゃない。
で、状況はどうなの、ヤドヴィガ？

localizations.en: Didn't I say as much... So, what's the verdict, Jadwiga?

999008199.text:
状況、分析。
住民の症状は胞子の毒素によるもの

localizations.en: Analyzing situation. Residents' symptoms are caused by spore toxins.

999008199.text:
なら、毒素を抜く薬を作らなきゃ！
レスナに相談――って、レスナもやられてるんだった

localizations.en: Then we need to make an antidote! We could ask Resna, but... she's been affected too.

999008199.text:
薬のレシピの提案あり。
原因となった胞子を採取、分析する

localizations.en: Proposing a remedy. Will collect and analyze the spores responsible.

999008199.text: 薬、作れるってことね！

localizations.en: You mean you can make the medicine?!

999008199.text:
ヴァレリア姉上以降の九偉人には、
調合機能が組み込まれている

localizations.en: All members of the Miraculous Nine after Valeria were built with synthesis capability.

999008199.text:
ただ、姉上は戦闘機能重視。
私とキューンは、錬金術のほうに長けている

localizations.en: However, Valeria was optimized for combat. Quinn and I have greater aptitude for alchemy.

999008199.text:
０から１を生み出す創造性は、
人間の錬金術士には及ばないものの――

localizations.en: Our capacity for creative synthesis falls short of a human alchemist's—

999008199.text: 今回のような、原因が明確な問題への対処は得意

localizations.en: But responding to a problem with a clear cause like this is well within our abilities.

999008199.text:
上出来さね、お前さんに従おう。
ほら、みんな！　必要な素材を集めるよ！

localizations.en: Good enough for me. I'm with you. Come on, everyone—let's go gather what we need!

999008199.text: ありがと。ヤドヴィガがいて助かったわ

localizations.en: Thank you. I'm really glad you're with us, Jadwiga.

999008199.text: よかった……みんな治るんだね……！

localizations.en: Everyone's going to be okay... They're all going to be cured...!

999008199.text: ……私は、遂行可能なことを遂行しているだけ

localizations.en: ...I am simply executing what can be executed.

999008199.text: でも、悪くないだろ？　感謝されるってのは

localizations.en: Still feels pretty good though, doesn't it? Being thanked.

999008199.text: ……嬉しい。不思議な感覚
じゃ、面倒ごとはさっさと片付けちゃおっか

localizations.en: Alright then, let's get this mess sorted out nice and quick.

999008199.text:
ええ！　みんなで力を合わせて、
町の人たちを元に戻す薬を作るわよ！

localizations.en: Right! Everyone together—let's make that medicine and get these people back on their feet!
